title: Battery Swapping solution for Electric Vehicles
tagline: You are limited by Mind, Not by battery of your Electric Vehicles.
description: People are not using electric vehicles because they can't go beyond a distance without recharge the batteries. We are proposing a solution to this by swaping the discharge battery with chargered one.
how_its_made: Main problem in this solution is trust. How a random car owner can trust a charging station is providing a genuine battery.
